title: Amphitheatre of Mérida
scope: The excavated Roman amphitheatre at Mérida, including the surviving lower stone terraces, longitudinal vaulted approaches, retaining podium and exposed central arena pit.
limitations: The outline and podium assembly retain the named archaeology’s mapped dimensions. The partially fallen upper masonry, exposed pit depth, gallery sections, modern repairs and worn stone texture are approximate.
The model represents the excavated remains, including only the visible portions of seating and masonry. The neighboring Roman theatre, circus and Amphitheatre House are separate sites.
The original bare terrain sampling is preserved. A local clearance exposes the arena and its pit where the coarse field cannot resolve the excavation.
